description_en: Configures application recording and saves the output to OSS
description_zh: 配置APP录制，输出内容保存到OSS中
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-app-record-config --domain-name example.com --app-name 'liveApp****' --oss-endpoint oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com --oss-bucket 'liveBucket****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLiveAppRecordConfig

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. The AppName must match the AppName in the ingest URL for the template to take effect. If you do not want to restrict the AppName, you can enter an asterisk (*) to match all AppNames
parameters.help_zh: 播流所属应用名称。AppName名称与推流地址中的AppName名称对应，模板才能生效。若不限制AppName可填*，即可匹配所有AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint of OSS.

To store live recordings in OSS, you must create an OSS bucket in advance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储的Endpoint名称。

直播录制文件存储至OSS，需提前创建OSS Bucket，创建方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OSS bucket.

To store live recordings in OSS, you must create an OSS bucket in advance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储的Bucket名称。

直播录制文件存储至OSS，需提前创建OSS Bucket，创建方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The stream name. The StreamName must match the StreamName in the ingest URL for the template to take effect. If you do not want to restrict the StreamName, you can enter an asterisk (*) to match all StreamNames under the AppName
parameters.help_zh: 播流名称。StreamName名称与推流地址中的StreamName名称对应，模板才能生效。若不限制StreamName可填*，即可匹配AppName下所有StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the recording. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The specified time must be within 7 days after the actual stream ingest start time. This parameter is valid only for stream-level recording, where StreamName is not empty
parameters.help_zh: 录制开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 设置的时间必须是实际推流时间开始7天之内，只在流级别录制（StreamName不为空）有效
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the recording. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The difference between EndTime and StartTime must not exceed 7 days. If the difference exceeds 7 days, it is calculated as 7 days. This parameter is valid only for stream-level recording, where StreamName is not empty
parameters.help_zh: 录制结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 EndTime与StartTime相差不应超过7天，超过7天将按照7天计算。只在流级别录制（StreamName不为空）有效
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable on-demand or manual recording. Valid values:

0 (default): Disabled. Automatic recording is used.
1: On-demand recording by using HTTP callbacks. You must first call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847891.html operation to configure OnDemandUrl. Otherwise, recording is disabled by default.
2: On-demand recording by parsing ingest parameters.
7: Manual recording. Recording is disabled by default. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847882.html operation to manually start or stop recording
parameters.help_zh:
按需/手动录制。取值：

0(默认值)：关闭，即自动录制。
1：按需录制，通过HTTP回调方式。需要先通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847891.html接口配置OnDemandUrl，否则默认不录制。
2：按需录制，通过解析推流参数。
7：手动录制，默认不录制，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847882.html接口手动控制录制开启或停止
parameters.name: on_demand

parameters.help_en:
The stream interruption splicing duration.
If the stream interruption duration exceeds the specified splicing duration, a new file is generated. The stream interruption splicing duration ranges from 15 to 21,600 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
断流拼接时长。
直播断流时长超过设定的拼接时长后，将会生成新文件，断流拼接时长支持15~21600秒
parameters.name: delay_time

fields.help_en:
The periodic recording length. Unit: seconds.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is used. The default value varies based on the recording format: 6 hours for m3u8 and cmaf, and 1 hour for flv and mp4.
If a stream interruption occurs within a recording cycle but the stream is ingested normally again within the stream interruption splicing duration, the recording continues in the same recording file.
A recording file is generated only when a live stream is interrupted for a duration that exceeds the stream interruption splicing duration
fields.help_zh:
周期录制时长。单位：秒。

若不填则取默认值，不同录制格式的默认值不同：m3u8、cmaf 格式默认6小时，flv、mp4格式默认1小时。
如果在一个录制周期内，直播流发生了断流，但是在断流拼接时长内，该直播流又正常推流，那么仍会在同一个录制文件中继续录制。
一条直播流必须断流超过断流拼接时长，才会生成录制文件
fields.name: cycle_duration

fields.help_en:
The format. M3U8, FLV, MP4, and CMAF are supported. Valid values:

<notice>You must specify at least one of RecordFormat and TranscodeRecordFormat. If you select the m3u8 or cmaf format, you must also set the RecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix and RecordFormat.N.SliceDuration request parameters.
</notice>

m3u8
flv
mp4
cmaf
fields.help_zh:
格式。目前支持M3U8、FLV、MP4、CMAF。取值：

<notice>RecordFormat和TranscodeRecordFormat两者至少需要设置一个。如果选择m3u8或cmaf格式，必须同时设置请求参数RecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix和RecordFormat.N.SliceDuration。
</notice>

m3u8。
flv。
mp4。
cmaf
fields.name: format
oss_object_prefix

fields.help_en:
The segment length. Unit: seconds.

<notice>This parameter is valid only when RecordFormat.N.Format is set to m3u8 or cmaf.
</notice>

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 30. Valid values: 5 to 30
fields.help_zh:
单个切片时长。单位：秒。

<notice>当RecordFormat.N.Format（格式）设为m3u8或cmaf时，本参数才有效。
</notice>

不填则默认为30秒。取值范围：5s~30s
fields.name: slice_duration

fields.help_en:
The segment name.

<notice>You need to configure this parameter only when RecordFormat.N.Format is set to m3u8 or cmaf.
</notice>

By default, a segment is generated every 30 seconds. The name is less than 256 bytes in size and supports variable matching, including {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.
The parameter value must contain the {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence} variables
fields.help_zh:
切片名称。

<notice>当RecordFormat.N.Format（格式）设为m3u8或cmaf时，本参数才需要配置。
</notice>

默认30秒一片，小于256字节，支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}。
参数值必须包含{UnixTimestamp}和{Sequence}变量
fields.name: slice_oss_object_prefix

fields.help_en:
The periodic recording length for transcoded stream recording. Unit: seconds.

fields.name: cycle_duration

<notice>If you select the m3u8 or cmaf format, you must also set the TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix and TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceDuration request parameters.

cmaf

<notice>如果选择m3u8或cmaf格式，必须同时设置请求参数TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix和TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceDuration。
</notice>

m3u8。
flv。

cmaf
